notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: 'Russ J Rampton' in the Name of Candidate box, on the affirmation line and on all three inner sheets, where index.csv's channel label is 'Russ Rampton' — the page face carries the middle initial and governs; the divergence is recorded, not resolved. The Office box prints 'County Clerk' (not 'Utah County Clerk'), agreeing with index.csv. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding Convention'; amendment answered 'No'; Date of Report 04/04/2022 on the cover and on every inner sheet. FORM: `v. 4.20` blank (five report types, 'Address and Zip Code' column, no in-kind column, close box UNLETTERED), born-digital fillable and typed, printed and re-scanned. THE PDF IS A DUPLEX SCAN (§J3): 10 PDF pages = 5 physical sheets, every odd page a report page and every even page a genuinely blank verso — all five versos were read full-page and are blank. The filing's own foliation is a plain sequence 1, 2, 3, 4 on the four report pages, so the fifth sheet (PDF p9) is the clerk's CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST and not part of the report. Page classification was done from each page's own printed header: PDF p1 cover, p3 Schedule A, p5 Schedule B, p7 SUMMARY PAGE, p9 checklist. THE CHECKLIST is the HOLD / 'Staff Signature #1' / '#2' revision with none of the Website / Network / HOLD boxes ticked; the red review copy is signed but its Date Reviewed line is LEFT BLANK, while the purple copy is dated 4/4/2022 — an honest blank in a clerk work product, recorded because the two review copies differ. It carries no dollar figures and is not a summary page. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES ALTERNATE SHEET BY SHEET inside this one filing (§L6): 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' on pp1 and 5, 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' on pp3 and 7. REDACTION: the county blacked out the candidate's whole cover address row and his signature, and the STREET portion of every one of the eight donor addresses on Schedule A, leaving city, state and zip legible in every case — a consistent per-cell practice on this filing, unlike others in this chunk where one row's city was also covered. The candidate's phone and email are published in the clear on the cover and are deliberately not carried into this record. BOTH SIDES CLOSE TO THE CENT on their own printed subtotals, on the schedules' sum-of-all-pages totals and on the promoted per-period boxes. THREE OF EIGHT CONTRIBUTION ROWS ARE CANDIDATE LOANS (1,150.00 of the 1,975.00 total) and are published as contribution rows because the document's own ladder requires them. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both sheets: every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or organisation, every address cell a city/state/zip, every purpose cell a purpose. ROW-INDEX TRAPS screened on both sheets: first written entry on band 1 (crop-proved on each), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, no doubled band, and nothing below the last printed rule (crop-proved outside the grid on the FULL Schedule B sheet, where the risk is real). NOTE FOR THE COORDINATOR: this filing itemizes NO candidate filing fee, which the county's other 2022 filings all carry — consistent with a Convention-period report filed before the fee was paid, observed and not adjudicated, and in any case the filing fee is never used to corroborate anything (§E1/§F5/§L3).
